qualificationFinding: Best-of-two planning/critique improves governance and prevents weak promotion, but text-driven implementation generation remains the quality bottleneck. Additional critics alone are not sufficient to cross the >=92 target. The next capability experiment should make implementation itself screenshot/vision-conditioned and allow a bounded rendered correction inside each isolated candidate, while preserving the same upstream creative ownership and frozen baseline.
baselineScoreCaveat: The frozen baseline has previously calibrated at 89. This run scored it 84 because the visual reviewer also penalized non-visual evidence scope. The three-way relative decision and hard >=92 candidate threshold remain the governing result; the 84 baseline score is not promoted as a new canonical quality truth.
